overview: Drawer is a side panel for details and secondary tasks. A drawer can open another beside it with `useDrawerStack`.

default.title: Default
default.text: A single drawer: control it with `open`, `onDrawerClose` and `overlayClose`.

attached.title: Attached
attached.text: Pass `anchorEl` to open the drawer from an element of the page instead of the screen edge.

stacked.title: Stacked
stacked.text: `useDrawerStack` opens drawers beside each other: up to three on wide screens, two below 1198px. The ones behind are dimmed; clicking one goes back to it and closes the ones after it. On mobile only the top drawer shows, with a back arrow.

withActions.title: With actions
withActions.text: Pass `actions` to fix the action bar at the bottom of the drawer.

api.intro: Drawer renders the panel; `useDrawerStack` returns `drawerProps(id)` to spread on each drawer of a stack.
api.title: Title below the close bar; scrolls with the content.
api.actions: Action bar fixed at the bottom.
api.align: Screen edge the drawer opens from.
api.floating: Floating panel with margins and rounded corners. `false` attaches it to the edge.
api.overlayClose: Called by a click outside the drawer.
api.onBack: Shows the back arrow instead of the close button.
api.depth: Position in the stack. Set by `useDrawerStack`.
api.offsetX: Horizontal offset in px. Set by `useDrawerStack`.
api.hideOverlay: Skips the drawer's own scrim. Set by `useDrawerStack`.
api.dim: Dims a drawer behind another. Set by `useDrawerStack`.
api.onDimClick: Called by a click on a dimmed drawer. Set by `useDrawerStack`.
api.closeButton: Close button as an IconButton (`icon`) or a Button (`legacy`).

platforms.text: The same example in each library.

rules: Open a drawer from another only with `useDrawerStack`; do not set `depth`, `width`, `offsetX` or `dim` by hand.
Open the next drawer from a list item with a chevron.
A single drawer needs only `open`, `onDrawerClose` and `overlayClose`.
